subject: learning/ci-shared-execution-groups
statement: The code-gate runner still shares groups across GitHub, Forgejo, and local CI, but a required red now fail-fasts: it cancels sibling groups and does not start later phases. Checks declare optional phase (default 1); test-race and test-coverage are phase 2. code-gate run --cheap selects only phase 1. PrefetchMainline fetches the configured mainline before a run and warns when HEAD does not contain it, without merging or failing the gate.
intent: Keep two-job group membership identical on every surface while cutting pre-push waste when cheap checks are already red.
rationale: Required failures used to finish every peer. That made a gofmt miss pay 13-20 minutes of race and coverage. Phase 2 starts only after phase 1 is green so the two full ./... suites still overlap with each other, not with lint. Hosted --group jobs still cover the same required set (DINV-1).
fit_criterion: codegatemirror synctest proves a required red cancels same-group queued checks and never starts phase 2; an advisory red does not cancel. SelectCheap returns only phase-1 checks. Fingerprints include phase. Hosted workers still select entire groups.

provenance.note: Fail-fast and phase barrier on the shared group runner.
